oem-odm: OEM / ODM enquiries
Start with a clear garment brief. We use your selected catalog style and requirements to discuss the scope of a possible B2B order.
Prepare your brief

Send the style reference, intended use, fabric preference, size breakdown, colours, artwork and destination. Identify which details are essential and which can be discussed. A catalog entry is a starting point for an enquiry, not confirmation of custom production capabilities.
Agree the scope

Fabric, measurements, decoration, packaging and any requested testing should be discussed before an order is agreed. Do not assume that an image confirms composition, certification or performance. MOQ and lead times are confirmed in writing in the quote.
Samples before an order

Use the sampling page to describe the sample you need and the shipping page to discuss the destination. Sample fees, MOQ and lead times are confirmed in writing in the quote. No order is accepted by submitting this form.
sampling: Sampling
Use a sample enquiry to define the garment, fabric and measurements you want to assess before discussing a bulk order.
Specify the sample

Include the catalog style, colour, fabric option, size and delivery destination. Attach or describe artwork requirements by email. Use the size chart associated with that style; measurements from another garment are not interchangeable.
Record the review

Describe the fit, fabric feel, measurements and decoration details you want to review. Ask for any required composition or testing information explicitly. Sample fees, MOQ and lead times are confirmed in writing in the quote; a sample request is not an order confirmation.
Plan for the season

For autumn and winter fleece styles, begin the discussion ahead of your intended selling season. For spring and summer, consider non-fleece or lighter options. Scheduling dates: Confirmed in quote. Sample fees and lead times are confirmed in writing in the quote; no fixed delivery date is promised.
shipping: Shipping
Shipping is discussed separately for each B2B enquiry. Give us the destination and requirements so the proposed arrangements can be recorded in the quote.
Destination and shipment details

Provide the country, delivery address or port, style references and quantity breakdown. Tell us about any packaging, labelling or document requirements before agreeing an order. Do not send sensitive identification documents through the enquiry form.
Confirm responsibilities

Ask for written confirmation of the proposed transport method, trade terms, freight responsibilities, customs clearance, duties and taxes. The website does not establish a shipping rate or an inclusive landed cost. Arrangements depend on the written quote and contract.
Timing and changes

Production lead times and transport schedules are confirmed in writing in the quote. A requested arrival date is a planning requirement, not a delivery promise. Notify us of destination or quantity changes before agreement so the shipping scope can be reviewed.
privacy: Privacy and cookies
This notice explains the enquiry information used by Sourcyo Apparel and the planned consent-based website analytics.
Enquiry information

The form collects name, business email, company and message, plus language and browser user-agent. A product reference may be included when supplied. The enquiry interface also accepts optional country, product reference, quantity note and source page. Please provide only information needed for your business enquiry; do not include sensitive personal information.
Purpose and storage

We use this information to respond to enquiries and discuss samples, quotations and B2B orders. Enquiry records are stored in Supabase in the United States, which involves transfer to that region. The contracting entity identified below handles requests about these records.
Analytics and consent

The planned analytics service is Google Analytics 4 (GA4), provided by Google LLC, to understand website visits, page use and enquiry journeys. Under Consent Mode v2, analytics_storage, ad_storage, ad_user_data and ad_personalization default to denied. Only necessary cookies are permitted by default; analytics will be enabled only after consent. This notice does not itself activate analytics.
Retention

The GA4 user and event data retention period and analytics cookie lifetime will be confirmed in writing before analytics is enabled. The enquiry retention period will be confirmed in writing before a contract is signed. No fixed retention period is specified here; contact us for the applicable arrangements.
Requests and choices

To request access, correction or deletion of enquiry information, email sales@sourcyowear.com and identify the relevant enquiry. Do not send additional sensitive documents unless needed to verify the request. You may also contact us to withdraw analytics consent. Any legally required retention will be explained when responding.
terms: B2B enquiry terms
This website supports business-to-business enquiries. Submitting a form does not place an order or create a sales contract.
Enquiry scope

Provide accurate business contact details and describe the style, fabric, size breakdown, destination and intended requirements. Catalog text and images are references for discussion. They do not establish an agreed specification, certification or quality guarantee.
Written quotations

Quote validity, specifications and commercial conditions must be stated in the written quotation. No standing validity period is set by this website. MOQ, sample fees and lead times are confirmed in writing in the quote. Payment, shipping and order acceptance require written agreement.
Intellectual property

Only submit artwork, logos and other materials that you are entitled to use and share for the enquiry. Submitting materials does not transfer ownership. Any permission to reproduce artwork for sampling or production must be agreed in writing; website content does not grant a general reuse licence.
Applicable law and disputes

Applicable law and the method and place of dispute resolution will be confirmed in writing before a contract is signed. This website does not select a governing law or jurisdiction. Any mandatory rights under applicable law remain unaffected.
Contract priority

If there is any conflict, the written contract prevails. Changes to specifications, delivery arrangements or other agreed terms require written agreement. Questions about an enquiry or these terms should be sent to sales@sourcyowear.com.

从明确的服装需求开始。我们以您选择的目录款式及要求为基础，讨论可能的企业间订单范围。
准备需求资料
请提供款式编号、使用场景、面料偏好、尺码数量分配、颜色、图稿及目的地，并注明必须满足与可讨论的细节。目录只是询价起点，不代表已确认具备某项定制生产能力。
确定具体范围
订单达成前，应讨论面料、尺寸、加工、包装及所需检测。请勿根据图片推定成分、认证或性能。最低起订量（MOQ）和交期均在报价中书面确认。
先沟通样品
请在打样页说明样品要求，在运输页沟通目的地。打样费、最低起订量和交期均在报价中书面确认。提交询盘表单不代表订单已被接受。
sampling: 打样
通过打样询盘明确需要评估的款式、面料和尺寸，再讨论大货订单。
说明样品要求
请提供目录款式、颜色、面料选项、尺码及收货目的地。图稿要求可通过邮件描述或发送。请使用对应款式的尺码表，不同款式的尺寸不能互相套用。
记录评估内容
请说明需要评估的版型、手感、尺寸及加工细节。如需成分或检测资料，应明确提出。打样费、最低起订量和交期均在报价中书面确认；申请样品不代表订单确认。
季节下单节奏
秋冬加绒款建议在目标销售季之前开始沟通；春夏可考虑不加绒或较薄的款式。具体排期日期：Confirmed in quote。打样费和交期均在报价中书面确认，不承诺固定交货日期。
shipping: 运输
运输安排按每份企业询盘单独讨论。请提供目的地和要求，以便在报价中记录拟议安排。
目的地与货物信息
请提供国家、收货地址或港口、款式编号及数量分配。包装、标签和单据要求应在订单达成前提出。请勿通过询盘表单发送敏感身份证明文件。
确认责任范围
请要求书面确认拟议运输方式、贸易条款、运费责任、清关、关税及其他税费。网站不构成运费报价或到岸总成本承诺；具体安排以书面报价及合同为依据。
时间与变更
生产交期及运输排期均在报价中书面确认。期望到货日是计划需求，不是交付承诺。目的地或数量变化请在达成协议前提出，以便重新评估运输范围。
privacy: 隐私与 Cookie

请求与选择

询价范围

报价有效性、规格及商务条件应载明于书面报价，网站不设统一有效期。最低起订量、打样费及交期均在报价中书面确认。付款、运输及订单接受须书面约定。

适用法律与争议
适用法律、争议解决方式及地点将在签约前书面确认。本网站不预设法律或管辖地。适用法律规定的强制性权利不受影响。
合同优先
如有冲突以书面合同为准。规格、交付安排或其他约定条件的变更须经书面同意。询盘或条款问题请联系 sales@sourcyowear.com。

Empiece con una descripción clara de la prenda. El modelo elegido del catálogo y sus requisitos sirven para estudiar un posible pedido entre empresas.
Prepare su solicitud

Indique modelo, uso previsto, tejido, distribución de tallas, colores, diseños y destino. Distinga los requisitos imprescindibles de los negociables. El catálogo es un punto de partida y no confirma capacidades de personalización.
Acuerde el alcance

Antes de acordar un pedido, detalle tejidos, medidas, acabados, embalaje y pruebas solicitadas. Una imagen no confirma composición, certificación ni prestaciones. El pedido mínimo (MOQ) y los plazos se confirmarán por escrito en la cotización.
Muestras antes del pedido

Describa la muestra en la página de muestras y el destino en la de envíos. Los costes de muestras, el MOQ y los plazos se confirmarán por escrito en la cotización. Enviar el formulario no implica la aceptación de un pedido.
sampling: Muestras
Defina la prenda, el tejido y las medidas que desea evaluar antes de hablar de un pedido de producción.
Detalle la muestra

Indique modelo del catálogo, color, tejido, talla y destino. Envíe o describa los diseños por correo. Utilice la tabla de tallas del modelo correspondiente; las medidas de otra prenda no son intercambiables.
Documente la evaluación

Describa el ajuste, tacto, medidas y acabados que desea revisar. Solicite expresamente la información de composición o ensayos que necesite. Los costes de muestras, el MOQ y los plazos se confirmarán por escrito en la cotización. Solicitar una muestra no confirma un pedido.
Planificación estacional

Para modelos afelpados de otoño e invierno, inicie la consulta antes de la temporada de venta prevista. Para primavera y verano, considere opciones sin afelpado o más ligeras. Fechas: Confirmed in quote. Los costes de muestras y plazos se confirmarán por escrito en la cotización; no se promete una fecha fija de entrega.
shipping: Envíos
El envío se estudia por separado para cada consulta B2B. Indique destino y requisitos para documentar la propuesta en la cotización.
Destino y mercancía

Facilite país, dirección o puerto, referencias y cantidades. Comunique las necesidades de embalaje, etiquetado y documentación antes de acordar el pedido. No envíe documentos de identidad sensibles mediante el formulario.
Responsabilidades

Solicite confirmación escrita del transporte, condiciones comerciales, gastos de envío, despacho aduanero, aranceles e impuestos. El sitio no fija tarifas de envío ni un coste total puesto en destino. Rigen la cotización y el contrato escritos.
Plazos y cambios

Los plazos de producción y transporte se confirmarán por escrito en la cotización. La fecha de llegada solicitada es una necesidad de planificación, no una promesa de entrega. Avise de cambios de destino o cantidad antes del acuerdo para revisar el alcance del envío.

Consigner l’évaluation

Décrivez la coupe, le toucher, les mesures et les finitions à examiner. Demandez expressément les informations de composition ou d’essais nécessaires. Les frais d’échantillonnage, le MOQ et les délais seront confirmés par écrit dans le devis ; une demande d’échantillon ne confirme pas une commande.
Anticiper la saison

Pour les modèles molletonnés d’automne et d’hiver, engagez les discussions avant la saison de vente visée. Au printemps et en été, envisagez des modèles non molletonnés ou plus légers. Dates : Confirmed in quote. Les frais d’échantillonnage et délais seront confirmés par écrit dans le devis ; aucune date fixe de livraison n’est promise.
shipping: Expédition

Destination et marchandises

Indiquez le pays, l’adresse ou le port, les références et les quantités. Présentez vos exigences d’emballage, d’étiquetage et de documents avant l’accord. Ne transmettez pas de pièces d’identité sensibles par le formulaire.
Répartition des responsabilités

Demandez une confirmation écrite du transport, des conditions commerciales, des frais, du dédouanement, des droits et taxes. Le site ne fixe ni tarif d’expédition ni coût total rendu à destination. Les modalités relèvent du devis et du contrat écrits.
Délais et modifications

Anfrage vorbereiten

Nennen Sie Modell, Verwendungszweck, Stoffwunsch, Größenverteilung, Farben, Motive und Zielort. Kennzeichnen Sie zwingende und verhandelbare Details. Ein Katalogeintrag ist ein Ausgangspunkt und bestätigt keine bestimmten Anpassungsmöglichkeiten.
